falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 low was followed by a grinding recovery without a sharp V-bottom reversal; a break above pre-correction levels indicates this is not a similar bottoming structure but rather a shallow dip in an ongoing uptrend

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 14 would demonstrate that market stress has fully dissipated, contradicting the 'bottom' signal which requires lingering fear as a foundation for reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A bottom_2024_aug analog occurred during a rate-cutting cycle with yields already declining; if yields fall sharply now from current levels (~4.2-4.5%), it signals recession panic rather than a soft-landing bottom, invalidating the pattern match which requires stable/rising growth expectations

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
